title: Rise & Fall game state export
description: A game's state, exported for debugging or bug reports via the in-game menu's "Copy game export" action (see src/lib/gameStateExport.ts). A plain JSON file — open it in any text editor or JSON viewer. The game state itself lives in `gameStateZipped`, gzip-compressed and base64-encoded to keep the file small; decode it with `encodeGameStateExport`/`decodeGameStateExport` in src/lib/gameStateExport.ts, or manually via base64-decode -> gunzip -> JSON.parse.

schema.description: Identifies this file as a Rise & Fall game state export.

version.description: Export format version, bumped if the encoding of gameStateZipped ever changes.

exportedAt.description: When the export was generated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

gameStateZipped.description: The game's engine.GameState (src/engine/types.ts), JSON-stringified, gzip-compressed, then base64-encoded.
